newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lawter EPS estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lawter EPS estimate cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it cut its third quarter earnings per share estimate by $0.02 a share to $0.16 and reduced its revenue estimate for the quarter to $48 million from $53.5 million.
-- "Management noted that sales growth, notably Europe, is below our original forecasts," analyst Jennifer Murtaugh said in a report.
-- A portion of the revenue weakness relates to a plant outage in Ireland. However, some of the revenue shortfall will be recouped from Lawter's insurance plan, she added.
-- A fourth quarter estimate of $0.18 a share is maintained.
-- EVEREN continues to rate the stock outperform, with intermediate and long-term price targets of $14 and $16 a share, respectively.
